extraction_notes: The provided full text did not include Supporting Information Table S2, which the paper says contains detailed catalytic results including CO2 conversion and product selectivities. Therefore conversion and per-entry CH3OH/CO selectivity values are left null. Figure 1c gives selectivity versus conversion, but individual points cannot be unambiguously mapped to a specific temperature/condition from the provided figure alone, so they were not extracted. Figure 1f contains many dense time-on-stream markers; only approximate start and end points were extracted. Literature-comparison Table S3 was not included and would be out of scope.
